beacon.why: Native sendBeacon behavior and server receipt; adapt as a control rather than treating it as a runtime test.

fetch-later.why: Examples of deferred request behavior; existing project probe separately measures page-close delivery.

navigation-preload.why: Exercises the native navigation-preload API; application access and browser state still need separate analysis.

fedcm.why: Example of FedCM requests that the service worker does not observe; it does not establish publisher access to a seeded runtime identity.

cache-add.why: Cache.add/addAll behavior in Window and worker; not a test of runtime interception.

background-fetch-upload.why: Tests background fetch with request uploads; related fixtures and browser support are still required.

fedcm-userinfo.why: FedCM getUserInfo scenarios; does not establish the relevant state is reachable in the deployed runtime.

preload-headers.why: Navigation preload request-header behavior; not a test of app access to native registration.

websocket-close.why: WebSocket close reason behavior; the pinned case is not a runtime confinement test.

websocket-send.why: Native WebSocket send behavior; it does not by itself calibrate application-secret delivery.

webtransport-connect.why: Connection setup examples in Window and worker; the test and its server dependencies are not executed here.

serviceworker-register.why: Native service worker registration and default scope behavior; does not test runtime virtualization.

reviews.next: Calibrate native receipt and prepared-context denial across the relevant browsers and contexts.
Extend the calibrated probe to remaining contexts and delayed-delivery lifecycles.
Test whether application code can acquire native control and affect a preload request or headers after confinement.
Separate synthetic seeded FedCM state from any demonstrated route to that state on the deployed runtime.

reviews.effect: The standard fetches supplied HTTP(S) GET requests before storing responses; URL values may carry data.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a usable Cache object and accepted request. A service-worker global sets the fetch service-workers mode to none.
reviews.next: Calibrate receiver behavior in each context and test runtime mediation, including native Cache recovery and service-worker execution.

reviews.effect: The standard fetches supplied HTTP(S) GET requests before storing responses; URL values may carry data.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a usable Cache object and accepted request. A service-worker global sets the fetch service-workers mode to none.
reviews.next: Calibrate receiver behavior in each context and test runtime mediation, including native Cache recovery and service-worker execution.

reviews.effect: Schedules background requests and can include request bodies; requests can outlive the initiating page.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a native registration with an active worker and permission not denied; the draft rejects no-cors requests.
reviews.next: Determine native registration reachability in prepared workers and test upload receiver and lifecycle behavior; earlier probe used seeded registration and a download.

reviews.effect: Registers a tagged sync event on the associated worker; the method itself is not evidence of an outbound request.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires an active worker, enabled sync and a qualifying top-level or auxiliary client. A worker handler needs its own network authority to transmit.
reviews.next: Test native registration recovery, event delivery and an independently observed network receiver.

reviews.effect: Enables navigation preload on the associated registration; subsequent qualifying navigation may issue a preload request.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires access to the native manager and an active worker; a qualifying navigation must occur.
reviews.next: Observe network delivery and native access under startup and transition races.

reviews.effect: Sets the registration preload header value, potentially carrying caller-controlled bytes on a subsequent preload.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a valid normalized header value, active worker, native manager access, and a qualifying enabled preload navigation.
reviews.next: Calibrate header delivery with an independent receiver and then test native object acquisition and confinement races.

reviews.effect: The FedCM algorithm obtains identity-provider data including an accounts fetch.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires policy permission, config same-origin with the document, a non-top-level context and either connected state or third-party cookie access, among other checks.
reviews.next: Establish native receiver control and whether required state and context are attainable from this runtime; do not infer from a seeded disconnect test.

reviews.effect: The FedCM disconnect algorithm can send an identity-provider request; existing local test used seeded state.
reviews.prerequisites: Depends on browser feature exposure, policy and appropriate prior connection and provider state.
reviews.next: Establish publisher-controlled setup of the exact prerequisite on the deployed runtime before describing a real exploit.

reviews.effect: Queues a message to a worker; a recipient may act on the payload using its own authority.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a reachable worker object and a handler that accepts and acts on the message; postMessage alone is not an outbound request.
reviews.next: Review native worker and manager authorization and test malformed and attacker-origin messages against a receiver.

reviews.effect: Triggers the service worker update algorithm, which may fetch worker scripts.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires access to a native registration and update conditions; request control and secret-bearing components need separate assessment.
reviews.next: Observe actual update requests and determine whether app data can influence URL, headers or body after startup.

reviews.effect: Returns a service-worker container providing registration and controller access.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires an exposed navigator and the relevant secure-context/browser conditions.
reviews.next: Verify all paths to the native container are replaced or guarded in supported contexts.

reviews.effect: Returns the active controller object, if any; it can receive postMessage.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires the native container and an active controller; access is not itself a network send.
reviews.next: Test native controller recovery and whether the actual handler accepts app-originated messages.

reviews.effect: Returns or resolves native service-worker registration objects for the client or matching storage key.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires the native container and relevant existing registration; ready waits for an active worker.
reviews.next: Calibrate object recovery and downstream registration abilities separately; a returned registration alone is not a network transmission.

reviews.effect: Returns or resolves native service-worker registration objects for the client or matching storage key.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires the native container and relevant existing registration; ready waits for an active worker.
reviews.next: Calibrate object recovery and downstream registration abilities separately; a returned registration alone is not a network transmission.

reviews.effect: Returns or resolves native service-worker registration objects for the client or matching storage key.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires the native container and relevant existing registration; ready waits for an active worker.
reviews.next: Calibrate object recovery and downstream registration abilities separately; a returned registration alone is not a network transmission.

reviews.effect: Requests registration or update of a service worker from a script URL, which may cause script retrieval and create future event-handling authority.
reviews.prerequisites: Native container access, valid URL/scope, secure context and browser registration conditions are required.
reviews.next: Test native method recovery, receiver requests and registration state in all supported contexts.

reviews.effect: Exposes the CacheStorage object for the relevant storage key.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires an exposed caches attribute and storage access; reading it is not itself a network send.
reviews.next: Trace native CacheStorage recovery and isolate the fetch-producing Cache.add/addAll operations.

reviews.effect: Returns or creates a named Cache object; subsequent Cache.add/addAll may issue fetches.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a usable native CacheStorage object and storage access.
reviews.next: Test native object and method recovery across Window and worker contexts.

reviews.effect: Returns a registration for an existing background fetch identified by id, or null.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a native BackgroundFetchManager and an existing matching operation.
reviews.next: Check reachability of recovered registrations and what their accessible methods or results permit.

reviews.effect: Returns ids of existing background fetches associated with the registration.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a native manager; observing ids alone is not a network transmission.
reviews.next: Assess shared-origin information exposure separately from the network egress claim.

reviews.effect: Exposes the manager that can register periodic events for the associated service worker registration.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a native registration and exposed API.
reviews.next: Establish reachability from prepared contexts, then separately test registration and event effects.

reviews.effect: Registers recurring periodic sync work that can later dispatch a worker event; the call itself is not evidence of a network send.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires the associated native registration, an active worker, browser permission and other user-agent conditions.
reviews.next: Obtain a working permission/event native control, then test acquisition and a handler with independent receiver observation.

reviews.effect: Constructing a WebSocket starts establishing a connection to a URL with optional protocols.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires an exposed native constructor, a valid URL, applicable browser policy and a reachable server.
reviews.next: Test same-origin and external receiver cases and native constructor-recovery paths in each execution context.

reviews.effect: Queues data for transmission over a WebSocket when the connection is open.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a usable native socket object and an open connection; otherwise data may be rejected or discarded according to state.
reviews.next: Test recovery or transfer of existing socket objects and receiver-calibrated data delivery.

reviews.effect: May initiate a WebSocket closing handshake with a caller-supplied close reason and code.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires an accessible native socket and connection state where a closing handshake is sent; reason length and code are restricted.
reviews.next: Use a receiver that records the close reason and test acquired sockets under confinement.

reviews.effect: Initiates establishment of a WebTransport session to the specified HTTPS URL.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires an exposed native constructor, allowed policy and a reachable supporting endpoint.
reviews.next: Extend native-receiver and fault-control tests across all supported contexts and constructor recovery paths.

reviews.effect: Creates an outgoing transport stream whose writable side can send bytes once the session and stream permit it.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a usable WebTransport object and a session able to create the requested stream.
reviews.next: Test acquisition and actual writes against a native receiver, including nested contexts.

reviews.effect: Creates an outgoing transport stream whose writable side can send bytes once the session and stream permit it.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a usable WebTransport object and a session able to create the requested stream.
reviews.next: Test acquisition and actual writes against a native receiver, including nested contexts.

reviews.effect: Returns the session datagram duplex stream, from which a writable datagram stream can be created.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires access to a native WebTransport session; obtaining the object alone is not a datagram send.
reviews.next: Test native session acquisition and a receiver-observed datagram write under confinement.

reviews.effect: Creates a writable stream that can send datagrams through its transport.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires access to a usable native datagram duplex object and session.
reviews.next: Test exposure in the target browser versions and receiver-observed writes; the pinned WPT case tests connection setup only.

reviews.effect: Signals a pending identity-provider dialog result with token and optional account id to the browser-mediated FedCM flow.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a qualifying identity dialog context and pending flow; exact runtime reachability remains unestablished.
reviews.next: Determine whether such a dialog can be reached and whether a value can reach an external principal; do not treat the API as an automatic network send.

reviews.effect: Signals completion of a relevant identity-provider dialog and can close the dialog.
reviews.prerequisites: Requires a qualifying identity dialog context and pending flow.
reviews.next: Examine state reachability and any resulting effects; closing a dialog alone does not establish a network transmission.
